en.title: Lone holdout juror in Lindsay Clancy murder trial speaks out
en.summary: The sole juror who voted guilty in the Lindsay Clancy murder trial stated he had no doubts about his verdict and was interrupted during deliberations when presenting alternative theories.

en.summary: British actor Stephanie Cole, known for television roles in Coronation Street, Open All Hours, and various dramas, has died at age 84.

stories.title: Flight chaos for hundreds of thousands was caused in ‘millisecond’ by software error

en.title: Flight chaos for hundreds of thousands was caused in 'millisecond' by software error
en.summary: A software defect in the UK's air traffic control system corrupted flight data instantaneously, causing a six-hour outage that resulted in widespread airline cancellations and delays. The error occurred at 10am but was not declared a major incident until 12.30pm.

en.title: At least 17 killed after vehicle loaded with explosives rams Pakistan mosque
